subject: Billing handoff: invoice generation authority & delivery path
messages:
From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Elena Soto <elena.soto@nrlabs.com>, Tom Briggs <tom.briggs@nrlabs.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com, connor.obrien@redwood.com
Date: 2025-11-20T09:12:00Z
Subject: Billing handoff: invoice generation authority & delivery path

Hi Elena / Tom,

Thanks for the quick onboarding call this morning. Before we flip the switch on the account, we need to lock down two small but important items so your AP team sees invoices exactly as required:

1) Who is the canonical invoice creator for North Ridge Labs (NRL)? Do you require Redwood to generate and send the invoice, or does NRL pull invoices from a portal/connector?

2) Delivery channel preference: portal push (preferred), SFTP nightly batch, or emailed PDF to an AP inbox. If emailed PDFs, please confirm the required To address and whether you need a signed/stamped PDF copy for reconciliation.

A few notes on VAT: because the majority of spend here will be cross-border EU, if NRL expects reverse-charge handling we'll need your VAT registration number + the legal billing entity to appear on the invoice.

Attached is our standard Invoice_Acknowledgement_Form — if you could return the filled form we'll map the billing contact and delivery choices into our billing system. Otherwise, table below shows typical defaults we can use: 
- Default (no portal opt-in): send PDF to invoices@nr-portal.com and cc finance@nrlabs.com; include PO if provided.
- Portal opt-in: we push both the machine-readable invoice (XML) and a PDF copy; customer can opt to suppress emailed PDFs.
- SFTP: scheduled nightly drops (CSV/XML).

Can you confirm preferred option and the billing legal name and VAT ID? If you want, we can schedule a 15-min AP handoff with Marissa to complete the form.

Thanks,

Grace O'Connor
Head of Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Invoice_Acknowledgement_Form.pdf (1 page - fillable)
From: Elena Soto <elena.soto@nrlabs.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Briggs <tom.briggs@nrlabs.com>, procurement@nrlabs.com
Date: 2025-11-21T08:04:00Z
Subject: Re: Billing handoff: invoice generation authority & delivery path

Hi Grace,

Thanks — quick answers from our side:
- Preferred delivery: portal push is ideal. Our AP team consumes the XML payload and archives the PDF.
- AP inbox for fallback/email copies: invoices@nr-portal.com (please include cc finance@nrlabs.com).
- Legal billing entity: North Ridge Labs Ltd (UK). VAT ID: GB123456789. We expect reverse-charge wording on cross-border invoices; our accounting needs a "stamped" invoice acknowledgement for internal audit (a signed PDF is fine).

We will complete the Invoice_Acknowledgement_Form and return by EOD Friday. Happy for Marissa to join a quick session if you need to demonstrate the portal push.

Best,
Elena
CFO, North Ridge Labs
From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Elena Soto <elena.soto@nrlabs.com>, Tom Briggs <tom.briggs@nrlabs.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com, connor.obrien@redwood.com
Date: 2025-11-22T10:33:00Z
Subject: Re: Billing handoff: invoice generation authority & delivery path

Elena — thanks, that helps. Two operational clarifications so we can proceed:

1) Portal push and XML schema: we support an "invoice push" webhook that delivers both the human PDF and machine XML (sample attached). If you want the XML to populate specific GL/PO fields, please point to the field mapping in the attached sample_invoice_xml_v2.xml and we can tweak the payload.

2) Stamped / signed copy: we can include a digitally signed PDF (PDF/A) marked "Customer Acknowledged" and add a signature block. We usually include that only on request to avoid extra manual steps, so glad you asked.

3) Interim fallback: while portal wiring completes, we will send emailed PDFs to invoices@nr-portal.com with the PO number in subject and a machine-readable attachment (XML).

Next steps I propose:
- You return the filled Invoice_Acknowledgement_Form (attached) by Friday 11/24.
- Ben from Sales Ops will register invoices@nr-portal.com in our routing and schedule a test invoice on Monday 11/24 (test will be a $0.00 invoice to validate fields).
- If PO numbers are mandatory, please confirm the PO format (e.g., NR-YYYY-####).

Attaching: sample_invoice_xml_v2.xml and a short note describing our stamped-invoice-protocol.

If that's all good I'll mark the account as portal-push ready and loop in our platform team for credential exchange.

Grace

Hi Elena / NRL AP team — looping you into the final configuration notes.

We have registered invoices@nr-portal.com as the fallback email and configured the portal-push credentials in our staging environment. Grace will flag when you return the filled acknowledgement form.

Planned immediate actions:
- 2025-11-24 16:00 UTC: push a test invoice (0.00) via portal with PDF + XML. Please confirm someone will watch the landing (or send a confirmation to this thread).
- If test fails, we'll send a single PDF to invoices@nr-portal.com matching the subject format: "Invoice NDG-4821 / PO: <PO_NUMBER>".

Also: Elena — could you confirm whether NRL requires the VAT ID to appear in line 1 of the invoice or in the header? Mapping that now avoids re-issuance.

Ben Carter
